name: Bottled Water
descriptions: A single-serving sealed bottle of purified water.
Neutral taste, essential for quenching thirst and basic hydration.
effects: Quenches immediate thirst.
Restores basic hydration without affecting energy.

name: Electrolyte Sports Drink (500ml)
descriptions: A flavored sports drink with added electrolytes and sugars.
Good for replenishing salts after heavy sweating.
effects: Replaces electrolytes and helps reduce cramping.
Provides a moderate sugar boost for short-term stamina.

name: Coconut Water (330ml)
descriptions: Natural coconut water in a sealed carton, mildly sweet.
Contains potassium and natural electrolytes for gentle rehydration.
effects: Offers natural electrolyte replenishment.
Light, refreshing hydration with a subtle sweetness.

name: Drinkable Yogurt Bottle (200ml)
descriptions: A sealed drinkable yogurt — creamy, tangy, and portable.
Provides both hydration and a small meal-like fullness.
effects: Satisfies light hunger while providing fluids.
A source of calcium and probiotics for digestion.

name: Energy Drink Can
descriptions: Carbonated energy beverage with caffeine and sugar.
Designed for a quick alertness boost over a short period.
effects: Sharp increase in alertness and perceived energy.
Short-lived stamina boost; can feel jittery if taken on an empty stomach.

name: Cold Brew Coffee Bottle (250ml)
descriptions: Ready-to-drink cold brew for a concentrated caffeine lift.
Low in sweetness, high in caffeine-driven alertness.
effects: Improves focus and wakefulness.
Mildly hydrating while primarily delivering caffeine.

name: Iced Tea Bottle (400ml)
descriptions: Sweetened iced tea in a recyclable bottle.
A lightly caffeinated, refreshing option with a touch of sugar.
effects: Provides gentle hydration with a small caffeine lift.
Pleasant, thirst-satisfying flavor.

name: Fruit Juice Box (200ml)
descriptions: Single-serve fruit juice (mixed fruit) with natural sugars.
Quick source of calories and light hydration.
effects: Restores a small amount of hydration and energy.
Good for a quick snack-like boost.

name: Oral Rehydration Solution Sachet
descriptions: Powdered electrolyte mix to be dissolved in one liter of clean water.
Formulated for rapid rehydration in case of heavy fluid loss.
effects: Must be mixed with water before drinking; restores salts and fluids efficiently.
Helps recover hydration more effectively than plain water alone.

name: Powdered Milk Sachet
descriptions: Single-serving powdered milk to mix with water for a quick milk drink.
Good for adding calories and modest fullness when fresh dairy is unavailable.
effects: Mix with water to make a light, nourishing drink.
Supplies calories and a small protein boost.

name: Sparkling Water Can
descriptions: Carbonated water with a crisp mouthfeel and zero sugar.
Refreshing alternative to still water; lightly hydrating.
effects: Refreshes and hydrates with a fizzy sensation.
No calories, suitable between meals.

name: Reusable Insulated Water Bottle (750ml)
descriptions: Double-walled stainless steel bottle that keeps drinks hot or cold for hours.
Designed for repeated use; reduces waste and keeps beverages at the right temperature.

name: Collapsible Silicone Cup
descriptions: Fold-flat silicone cup for drinking on the go.
Lightweight and easy to pack in a hydration kit.

name: Reusable Gel Ice Pack
descriptions: Small reusable ice pack to keep bottles and perishables cool inside a bag.
Freeze before use; helps maintain low temperatures in a compact kit.

name: Bottled Spring Water (500ml)
descriptions: Clear plastic bottle with a resealable cap.
Clean, neutral-tasting spring water for quick hydration.
effects: Quickly quenches thirst and soothes dry mouth.
Helps relieve mild dehydration and clears the head.

name: Electrolyte Drink Bottle
descriptions: Ready-to-drink isotonic beverage with added salts and minerals.
Slightly salty-sweet flavor designed to restore electrolytes.
effects: Rehydrates faster than plain water and eases light muscle fatigue.
Good after exercise or long days in heat.

name: Instant Lemonade Sachet
descriptions: Powdered lemonade mix in a single-use sachet; mix with water.
Tangy and sweet; lightweight and shelf-stable.
effects: When dissolved, produces a refreshing drink that mildly restores hydration and energy.
Portable way to flavor water and encourage drinking.

name: Dried Fruit Mix Sachet
descriptions: Single-serve mix of dried apricots, mango, and raisins.
Chewy, fiber-rich snack with natural sugars.
effects: Provides a moderate fullness and natural energy without needing refrigeration.
Good for snacking and a gentle sugar boost.

name: Insulated Bottle Sleeve
descriptions: Neoprene sleeve that fits a standard water bottle to help keep drinks cold.
Lightweight and stretchable, with a small carry loop.

name: Reusable Stainless Straw (folding)
descriptions: Collapsible stainless steel straw with a small carry case.
Easy to clean and reduces single-use waste.
